string.text: According to General Voronin, only Freedom has one of these guns. How I get it is my own business. I was told that one way would be to hang out with the Freedom stalker called Chef. The General says he likes his drink more than he should. I should stock up on vodka just in case I can use it.
ブレイン・スコーチャーの方面から来る襲撃を防ぎ、バリアを守る。

Lukash: "If you have it in you, you can go to the security checkpoint by the exit to the Scorcher - based on some indications they're expecting another attempt at a break-in from the mutants or Monolith."
Freedom has acquired grenade launchers. Two of them. One is in the arsenal, the other somewhere in the village.\n\n
ルカシュ「残念だが、仲間に密告者がいる。パヴリクという男だ。敵に情報を流しているから、止めなければならない。農場まで尾行して、誰に情報を渡しているのか突き止めてくれ。少し前に出たから、追いつく必要がある。いいか、あいつは始末して構わないし、始末すべきだ。だが、情報の受け渡し相手が分かるまでは手を出すな。その相手も排除してくれ」

... today we went to the village again on a hunt. Everything same as always. 
... Where did that beast come from? Must have sneaked through near the Scorcher. All the guys are down, I'm the only one standing... I'll try to sneak out at night... 
 
... I don't remember how I got out. It was pure hell... My head is splitting open - pictures, sounds, I don't know where they are coming from. Goddamn radiation. On top of that, the bloody detector is kaput. I must rest and I'll feel better.
Crazy stalker's PDA
デューティー隊員とともに基地へ入る。\n狙撃手を3人排除する。 \nルカシュを始末する。
塔にいる狙撃手を倒す。眉間を撃ち抜かれないよう気をつける。

Crap, those Duty assholes kicked us out from a fat place. They dug in near our farmstead. We didn't even have time to get our things from the attic. No big deal though - Freedom base is near, so they won't hang on too long.
Bandit from the farmstead PDA
Today we shook down a few soldiers on their way to Red Forest - scored some grenade launchers. They are awesome. Lukash took one, and Murk hid the other in the village, in one of the basements.
Max's PDA

1. The Devil made me go to the Brain Scorcher forest. I barely made it - a little slower and I would have made for yet another exhibit with liquefied brains.
2: Four thugs surrounded me like I was a three-year old. I did my part - didn't see their trap. I was only saved by their chattiness and greed. Instead of stuffing me full of lead, they jumped out and began disarming me - got hooked on the suit. That was their last mistake; still, one of them caught me with a bullet... heh, I'm getting old...
3: By the time I arrived, Strelok's messenger was no longer breathing. Three bloodsuckers are a match for anyone, but this guy took out four of them, and a few more bloody trails lead out in different directions. The only information on him is a door code (19840519), but identifying the door it unlocks doesn't seem possible.
4: We intercepted a few army men on their way to the Scorcher. They carried no documents or orders, but were very adequately equipped. I think I'll leave that grenade launcher in the basement until I need it.
Murk's PDA

ヴォロニン「フリーダムは優秀なグレネードランチャーを何丁か持っている。領内に潜入して1丁でも盗み出せれば、十分な報酬を払おう。君は我々の隊員ではないから、フリーダムとも打ち解けやすいはずだ。うまくいけば、ランチャーを持ち出せるだろう。フリーダムの本拠地の位置情報を送る。中に入ったら、シェフという男を探してほしい。古参の隊員だから、ランチャーの保管場所を知っているはずだ。彼は酒に目がない。それを利用できると考えて、彼に目をつけた。ウォッカをたっぷり持っていくといい」
報酬は、フリーダム基地のスキンフリントから受け取るらしい。いかにもけちな名前だ。去年で賞味期限の切れた肉の缶詰でも渡されるんじゃないだろうな。
村のブラッドサッカーを一掃する。油断すれば、血を吸い尽くされて殺される。
Clean out the bloodsuckers in the village. Got to watch my back or they'll drain my blood and leave me for dead.
ルカシュは、農家にいるデューティー部隊への反撃を決めた。作戦を率いるのは、フリーダムのベテランであるマックスだ。自分の役目は彼らへの援護だ。
沼地にいる、正気を失った男は何を知っているのだろう。確かめてみる。まずは古い地雷に気をつけなければ。ボルトを投げつけただけでも爆発するかもしれない。
Pavlik's PDA

My function, as the designated medic of the expedition, was to monitor the behavior of all its members. The Captain gave me this responsibility, and I understand why he did it: being in such close proximity to the Burner, one should always be very attentive not only to one's own behavior, but also to the behavior of his companions! This is because any change in behavior is an indication that the group is straying too close to the dangerous effects of the Scorcher, where mere meters may indicate the difference between staying alive and getting fried. The day before, I spoke with the stalker-hunter nicknamed Raven, who volunteered to be our guide for a while. He said that he had been to these territories once before and had not experienced any influence from the radiation. However, everyone's psyche is different, so we shouldn't relax and assume the area is safe for all of us. \Last time I warned everyone not to consume any strong drinks or drugs while on the expedition, except for medication. \n\n %c[255,255,128,0]I hid some stuff on the outskirts of the abandoned village, in a bin next to the tower. When I came back to pick it up, I was shocked to see mutants swarming all over the place. I'll have to put it off indefinitely...%c[default]

In the evening, after the Medicine Man relieved me from sentry duty, I laid down and wanted to get a good night's rest before tomorrow but for some reason I could not fall asleep. In the end I gave up the effort, grabbed my rifle, and, having warned the healer, set off for the nearest hill near the abandoned village. I wanted to look at the starry sky, to listen to the sounds of the night. Why I suddenly felt a craving for romance - I do not know ... I sat and admired the stars for a long time, did not even care to check the time - I did not want to. Before me, in a small valley between the hills lay the dead village. Suddenly, a flutter in the darkness caught my attention. I looked more closely and there it was, on the northern edge of the village, a faint white light flickered from the window of a half-decayed hut. A moment later, a faint pale light flickered next to it in another house. Soon, mysterious lights appeared in several other places in the abandoned village. I began fumbling through my backpack, hoping to find my binoculars in the pitch black darkness when suddenly a hand gently rested on my shoulder and a soft voice above my ear whispered: "It's poltergeists. They light candles left in houses at night - for the repose of those who passed away here." I turned around. Raven, our hunter guide, was standing behind me. He was staring thoughtfully into the darkness of the night. \n\n %c[255,255,128,0]I stumbled upon a neutral loner camp not far from Freedom's base. They were smart guys, experienced. They invited me to their table and even offered me some vodka. I stacked some of my loot under some debris on a hill to the east of that camp, just in case.%c[default]

Everything that has a beginning must also have an end. It's only a matter of time before our life's journey comes to an end, too. In any case, we must solve this mystery of the Zone and find out what is behind the Scorcher. Even if it means we may never return, I don't care. 
Raven warned me about the danger in time, and I took his advice. I ordered all of us to split into groups of two and spread out in different locations. If we are being hunted, we should not take unnecessary risks by grouping together, and besides there's no need to hurry. We have the flexibility to move at the most opportune moment, all thanks to the thorough preparations we have made. We must wait and sit tight, caution beats recklessness. Raven said that the agents of the Monolith will soon receive misinformation from the hunters and cease their hunt. 

 %c[255,255,128,0]Hid some of the more valuable supplies donated to us by the Freedom faction on top of a train in the west part of the their base. They're good guys, and they're okay with our group.%c[default]

It's a strange place. Everywhere you go, you keep coming back to the point where you came from... It's madness! I think I'm in this for the long haul. Yet I do not intend to give up, my intuition has pulled me out of worse situations, and I have a feeling the exit is somewhere near...

Yesterday I had an appointment with this Raven. When I met him, he gave me a package. My task was to give it to the right person, who would be at the agreed upon place at the old hut in the middle of the swamp, in a day's time. He also asked me to keep this deal between us a secret and gave me two rare artifacts for the trouble: a "Mica" and some "Eye" - he said that it is good for back pain, it will have to try...
